key.name: toggle-collaboration
key.summary: Shortcut for Allow collaboration

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Watch the camera

key.name: camera-device
key.summary: Camera device path, or auto for the first physical camera

key.name: interval-ms
key.summary: Time between snaps in milliseconds; the camera's real framerate is the upper limit

key.name: model
key.summary: Face-recognition model

key.name: use-gpu
key.summary: Run the model on the GPU, which is faster but uses several hundred MB more memory

key.name: match-thresholds
key.summary: Minimum similarity for a face to count as yours, per model; a missing model uses its own default

key.name: detection-threshold
key.summary: Minimum detector confidence for something to count as a face

key.name: min-face-px
key.summary: Ignore faces smaller than this many pixels

key.name: absence-grace-s
key.summary: Seconds without your face before the screen locks

key.name: intruder-grace-s
key.summary: Seconds another face must stay before the action runs

key.name: intruder-action
key.summary: What to do when another face appears

key.name: intruder-command
key.summary: Shell command for the command action

key.name: intruder-workspace
key.summary: Workspace number for the workspace action

key.name: return-on-clear
key.summary: Return to the previous workspace once the other face has gone

key.name: minimize-apps
key.summary: Desktop file IDs of apps whose windows are minimized when another face appears

key.name: minimize-restore
key.summary: Restore the minimized windows once the other face has gone

key.name: python-path
key.summary: Python interpreter that has insightface installed

key.name: reference-stamp
key.summary: Changed whenever the reference image is replaced

key.name: enroll-active
key.summary: The preferences window is using the camera, so monitoring must pause
